```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.24.0'

      - name: Install golangci-lint
        run: |
          curl -sfL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/golangci/golangci-lint/master/install.sh | sh -s -- -b $(go env GOPATH)/bin v1.61.0

      - name: Run golangci-lint
        run: |
          golangci-lint run ./...

  build-and-test:
    needs: lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.24.0'

      - name: Check gofmt
        run: |
          diff -u <(echo -n) <(gofmt -d .)
          
      - name: Run go build
        run: |
          go build -v ./...

      - name: Run go test
        run: |
          go test -v ./...
```
